book.name: 1Tasolonqe Asaas
book.title: Phawuloosi Tasolonqe Asaas Xaafida Koyro Kiita

content: Ta ishatoo! Hessi hanana wodeza gishshas nu inttes xaafanaas koshshenna.
Kaysoy qamman yiza mala Godaa gallassika hessa mala yaanayssa intte intte baggara lo7eththi ereeta.
Asay, «Gadey saronne lo7okko» gishin miixay qanththara diza maccas oykkiza mala hessaththoka as dhayssizay qoppontta dishin asa bolla gakkana; oonikka kessi ekkenna.
Intteno ishatoo! He gallassay kayso mala inttena daganththanaas intte dhuman deekketa.
Intte wurikka poo7o nayta; nuni dhuma woykko qamma baggata gidokko.
Histtiko ane beeggoos; ane nurkka nuna haaroos attiin hankko dhiskiza asaa mala nunikka ane dhiskokko.
Dhiskizayti qammara dhiskeettes; maththottizaytikka qammara maththotteettes.

Nuni gidikko gallassa asata gidida gishshas ammanonne siiqo, tiran may7iza xurure may7o mala may7idi atoteththa hidota hu7en woththiza birata qoobe mala hu7en woththidi ane nunateththaa haaridi de7oos.
Xoossi nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa baggara atoteth demmana mala attiin nuna hanqos xeygibeenna.
Nu hayqqikokka woykko paxa diikkoka izara daana mala izi nu gishshas hayqqides.
Hessa gishshas tumappe intte ha7i ooththizayssa malakka issoy issaara minettitenne minththeththite.
Wurseththa Zorenne Saroka
Histtiko ta ishatoo! Intte giddon minni ooththizayta Godaan inttefe bollara diza halaqatanne inttena zorizayta intte bonchchana mala nu inttena woossoos.
Istta ooso gishshassika istta siiqora lo7eththi bonchchite; intte intte giddon saron diite.
Ta ishatoo! Nu inttena, «Ooso ooththontta asata hanqettite; babbizayta minththite; daaburanchchata maaddite; as ubbaa dandayte» gi zoroos.
Oonaska iita gishshas iita zaarontta mala naagettite; gido attiin intte intte giddon gidiin hara asara gidiin ubba wode lo7o gidizayssa ooththanaas baaxetite.
Ubba wode ufayettite.
Qanxxontta woossite.
Ay hanonkka galatite; Xoossa sheney inttes Yesus Kirstoosa baggara hessa.
Xillo Ayana tama toyssofte.
Tinbite qaala kadhopite.
Wursika paacci xeellite; lo7o gididaaz oykkite.
Iita gidida ay miishshafekka haakkite.
Saroteththa Goday izi ubba miishshan inttena dummaso; intte ayanay, intte shemppoynne intte ashoy Godaa Yesus Kirstoosi yiza wode wosoy baynda naagetto.
Inttena xeygidayssi ammanettidaade gidida gishshas izi hessa ooththana.
Nu ishatoo! Nu gishshassika woossite.
Ammanizayta ubbaa geeshsha yeereteththan sarokkite.
Ha kiitay ammanizaytas ubbaas nababettana mala Godaa sunththan hadara gays.
Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa aadho kiyateththi inttenara gido.
